scene_summary: A highly cluttered temporary workspace set up on a white folding table, featuring three laptops, tangled cables, a router, personal items, and suitcases piled in the background.
risks_or_opportunities: Severe cable clutter across the center of the desk creates a high risk of snagging and pulling devices like the computer mouse or laptops off the table.
The workspace is heavily crowded with non-work items, leaving almost no room for ergonomic wrist support or proper mouse movement.
Large suitcases piled directly behind the seating area present a tripping hazard and block safe egress from the desk.
suggested_actions: Route and bundle the tangled cables connected to the silver laptop (closed), computer mouse, and router/modem to clear the central desk space.
Remove non-essential items such as the book "Hard Eight", the plastic bag, and the snack box (orange) from the table to free up space for comfortable arm placement.
Relocate the large suitcases to a closet or designated storage area to keep the walkway behind the chair completely clear.
confidence_notes: The overhead camera angle and bright direct lighting provide clear visibility of all items, though the dense clutter and overlapping cables make tracing individual wire paths slightly complex.
